purpose: Event highlight art for asset id art.event.adjudicated.v1 (ADJUDICATED highlight); flashed on the cell of a combatant whose action was just adjudicated. This is a REDO: the delivered asset replaces the current file one-for-one at promotion.
prompt: Event highlight overlay tile: a bright amber square frame highlight hugging the cell edges with a short inward glow of stepped alpha, transparent centre, crisp 1:1 pixels, no text.
negativePrompt: photograph, 3D render, isometric perspective, blur, anti-aliasing, smooth gradients, text, watermark, signature, border, frame

style.summary: Matches the repository's classic-board pixel art: 128 x 128 top-down tile, crisp 1:1 pixels, flat stepped shading with light from the top-left, shadows shifting toward blue-violet and lights toward yellow, the generated palette of eight hue ramps (stone, wood, earth, moss, cloth-warm, cloth-cool, metal, skin) plus cool-grey neutrals.
style.palette: Generated ramp palette, see src/assets/palette.ts; keep to the same hue families as the current asset.

background.notes: Transparent centre; only the highlight frame carries alpha.

acceptanceCriteria: File is a PNG, exactly 128 x 128, 8-bit RGBA.
Composition, footprint and transparency class match the current event-adjudicated-v1.png so the file is a drop-in replacement (same name at promotion).
Pixels are crisp: no anti-aliased edges, no smooth gradients; a 4x nearest-neighbour zoom shows only hard-edged pixels.
No text, signature, watermark, border or frame.
Centre transparent so the token remains fully visible.
Reads as a highlight, not a fog or overlay, at 1:1.
notes: Part of batch redo-starter-art-v1: a redo of every starter art asset. Recipe from src/assets/starter-art-inputs.ts: {"kind": "event", "material": "semantic", "mark": "adjudicated"}.
